summary: Five actual GLB views and full-resolution hero/front comparisons inspected against the approved high source and rejected manual r1. Cleaning zero-area data before reduction, retaining original UV/PBR and restoring retained corner normals preserves the rounded leafy canopy and branching stems at 14871 triangles. Fresh FBX/GLB checks pass with no degenerate/loose/non-manifold geometry. r4 uses the available triangle budget more effectively than the valid 11970-triangle r3 baseline.

issues.problem: Individual leaf outlines and root fibres are more angular/simplified than the high source, while canopy coverage and material variation remain coherent.

material_note: Preserve the original double-sided material. Normal.png is an unconnected flat placeholder; see texture-extraction.json.
